title: Patch: the aimed-attack preview names a Cleave attack's splash and a Trample attack's overflow

**Issue #4290 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4290: Patch: the aimed-attack preview names a Cleave attack's splash and a Trample attack's overflow
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When you aim an attack today, the numbers you see cover only the two cards in front of you: the blow onto the target and the strike back onto your attacker. Everything else the same attack deals is invisible. Aim a Cleaving unit at a middle blocker and the preview says nothing about the identical blow landing on both neighbors, even though the engine deals it even when a Divine Shield stops the main hit. Aim a Trample unit at a small blocker and the preview hides the excess going to the enemy hero, the very damage that ends the game. After this is built, hovering those attacks shows the splash on each neighbor and the overflow onto the hero, with the same destroyed and shield-broken markers the target already gets, so nobody misattacks because the preview understated their own attack.

## Why

- The engine already deals both hits: SPEC §4.4 step 10 (Cleave, which still happens when steps 1, 4 or the zero rule stop the main hit) and step 9 (Trample overflow as its own instance onto the hero). But the engine's per-attack forecast caps a Trample `dealt` at the target's health and discards the overflow, and it has no splash field at all, so the preview has nothing to show.
- Two private copies of this math already exist outside the forecast: the practice AI prices a Cleave splash and a Trample excess as a face hit, and open issue #4257 shows that copy is currently wrong beside a GIGA in its lanes. The R3100000 ruling retired the tutorial coach's private combat math for exactly this drift reason; the splash math never got the same treatment, and it is the subtler half (GIGA taking the one hit, a Ranged Cleaver still splashing, overflow never coming from a strike back).
- The fuzz's I18 oracle reads only the target's blow and the strike back, so the splash and the overflow are the one combat damage no gate holds to anything.

## Proposal

- Extend the engine's per-attack forecast with the attack's other hits, read from the board like the rest of it: for Cleave, one entry per neighboring unit run through the same pipeline steps the engine deals (Divine Shield, Armor, the unit's own cap, Indestructible; a GIGA neighbor taking the one hit; a Ranged attacker's splash landing; under the same conditions the engine's own Cleave call runs, including when the main hit is stopped); for Trample, the overflow instance onto the target controller's hero, projected through the hero's Armor and caps as a new instance, never from a strike back, a reflection, or card text.
- Hold the new entries in the fuzz by extending its shared oracle to read the splash and the overflow off the step's damage events (Cleave hits already ride tagged), and in the forecast's rules tests, where every forecast attack is already played for real; add a ruling amending R3100000 with those proofs.
- Show the entries in the aimed-attack preview: splash markers on the neighboring units and the overflow number on the hero, with tests.
- The AI's own splash counting stays out: it belongs to open issue #4257, not this patch.

## Where it lands

- SPEC §4.4 steps 9 and 10 (no rule change; the forecast is a derived fact), one new ruling note amending R3100000, and its §11 paragraph in the issue's `spec/pending/` file.
- `crates/engine/src/query.rs` (the forecast and its types), `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs` and `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` (the shared I18 oracle), `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs`.
- `apps/web/src/game/attackOutcome.ts`, `apps/web/src/game/AttackOutcome.tsx`, and their tests (markers only; the client still computes no combat math).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A Cleave attack's forecast entry names each neighboring unit's splash blow, and playing the attack for real deals exactly those amounts, including when a Divine Shield stops the main hit, beside a GIGA, and from a Ranged attacker.
- [ ] A Trample attack's forecast entry names the overflow instance onto the hero, and it matches the real overflow, including through the hero's Armor and the Anti-oneshot cap, and no strike back or defender ever reports one.
- [ ] The fuzz holds the new entries on every plain Cleave and Trample attack it plays, through the same oracle its forecast tests share.
- [ ] Aiming a Cleave attack marks each neighbor with its splash, and aiming a lethal Trample attack shows the hero's overflow; a non-Cleave, non-Trample attack's preview is unchanged.
- [ ] The new ruling cites the forecast tests, the fuzz oracle and the preview tests in `proven_in`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.

## Size and risks

Medium, about a week: engine forecast math plus tests, a fuzz-oracle extension, small client markers, one ruling. Difficulty hard (engine rules). Risks: the forecast must keep reading the board alone, never a hand or a face-down card (neighbors' shields and Armor are board-visible, so this holds); Stinkyscape sweep weights stay out of scope unless they fall out of the same call for free. Rejected: folding the splash into the target's `dealt` (it would lie about the target's blow and break the existing hold); simulating each attack with `reduce` (R3100000 already rejected it: it would run face-down traps); re-tuning the AI's splash pricing here (open issue #4257 owns it).

---

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44673437497)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A Cleave attack's forecast names each neighboring unit's splash blow and a Trample attack's forecast names the overflow instance onto the hero, both with the same destroyed and shield-broken markers the target already gets; the fuzz's shared oracle holds both on every plain attack; aiming those attacks shows the splash markers and the hero overflow number. The AI's own splash pricing and Stinkyscape sweep weights stay out (open issue #4257).

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `spec/rulings/R4290000.md` | new | Ruling amending `R3100000`: forecast gains splash and overflow, derived fact, no §4.4 rule change; `proven_in` lists the three test files below |
| `spec/pending/4290.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for `R4290000`, in the form `11-rulings.md` paragraphs use |
| `crates/engine/src/query.rs` | change | `AttackForecast`, new `SplashHit` / `TrampleOverflow` types, `forecast_attack`, one new neighbour helper (or reuse from `lethal.rs`) |
| `crates/engine/src/subsystems/lethal.rs` | change | Make `struck_by` `pub(crate)` so the forecast reuses the combat's own neighbour list; nothing else |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs` | change | `PlayedAttack`, `PlayedAttack::forecast`, `PlayedAttack::read` |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | change | I18 header/`foreseeable_attack` docs only: Cleave and Trample stay foreseeable |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs` | change | New `mod r4290000_…` tests; every case plays the attack for real via `forecast_played` |
| `apps/web/src/game/AttackOutcome.tsx` | change | New `AttackSplashPreview`, `AttackOverflowPreview` components (markers only, same tentative classes) |
| `apps/web/src/game/attackOutcome.ts` | change | One helper resolving the hovered entry's splash/overflow for a card or hero testid |
| `apps/web/src/game/Card.tsx` | change | Render the splash marker on a neighbour card named by the hovered entry |
| `apps/web/src/game/Hero.tsx` | change | Render the overflow marker on the hero named by the hovered entry |
| `apps/web/src/game/attackOutcome.test.tsx` | change | New `R4290000` describes/its |
| `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` | change | Only the files `cargo test` with the `ts` feature rewrites for the new forecast shape (commit any diff) |

Do not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` (issue #4257 owns the AI's splash pricing); `crates/engine/src/wire/events.rs` (`via: Cleave`/`via: Trample` already exist, R2783001); `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (the daily fold writes them); sweep weights in `crates/engine/src/combat.rs`. Governing spec: §4.4 steps 9–10 (steps 1, 4, zero rule, R63), §4.3 (R783000/R783001, First Strike), R3100000/R3477000/R4032000/R4111000, R176, R3546001, R2201000.

## Steps

1. `crates/engine/src/subsystems/lethal.rs`: change `fn struck_by` to `pub(crate) fn struck_by`. It already returns defender plus each adjacent unit via `giga::adjacent_slots` plus `is_adjacent_card`, GIGA-deduped (R3546001). No logic change.
2. `crates/engine/src/query.rs`, types: add `#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]` (+ the same `ts` attrs `AttackForecast` carries) `pub struct SplashHit { pub target_id: String, pub dealt: i32, pub kills: bool, pub pops: bool }` and `pub struct TrampleOverflow { pub dealt: i32, pub kills: bool }`. Add fields `pub splash: Vec<SplashHit>` (default empty for non-Cleave) and `pub overflow: Option<TrampleOverflow>` (`None` for non-Trample, hero targets, and strike backs) to `AttackForecast`. Update the struct's doc comment.
3. `crates/engine/src/query.rs`, `forecast_attack`: compute the existing `falls` first and keep every existing field byte-identical. Then, only when `target` is a unit and the attacker has layered Cleave (`has_keyword(&mine.keywords, …)`, exactly as `combat::cleave` reads it): for each unit in `lethal::struck_by(state, attacker, defender)` after the first, set `amount` to `mine.attack + bonus.attack` (the unmultiplied `cleave_amount` that `combat::strike` passes to `cleave`, so lane multipliers and sweep weights never touch it), `dealt` to `0` when `falls` else `hit_on_unit(state, attacker, neighbour, amount)`, `kills` to `dealt > 0 && (poisons || exiles || dealt >= health)`, `pops` to `!falls && amount > 0 && is_shielded(state, neighbour)`. This runs even when the main hit is stopped (shield, Indestructible, zero rule), matching `cleave` which is called from `strike` unconditionally, and for Ranged attackers (R783001).
4. Same function, overflow: only when `target` is a unit and the attacker has layered Trample: `dealt` is `lethal::projected_damage(state, attacker, target)` (fresh pools, as today) — for a unit target that is exactly the Cleave-inclusive Trample excess the trap window projects (R176, R44), so forecast and window cannot drift, including the First-Strike-destroyed case returning 0; `kills` is `lethal::is_lethal(state, attacker, target)`. Wrap as `Some` only when the gate holds, else `None`, so non-Trample previews are unchanged. Never compute this on the strike-back path: `forecast_attack` builds one entry per declared attack only.
5. `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs`: add `pub splash: Vec<crate::query::SplashHit>` and `pub overflow_dealt: i32, pub overflow_kills: bool` to `PlayedAttack`; `forecast` maps the entry's new fields (`overflow` `None` maps to `0`/`false`). In `read`, keep `dealt`/`taken`/`kills`/`survives`/`pops` exactly as now; add: `splash` from `GameEvent::Damage` with `via == Some(KeywordKind::Cleave)`, grouped by `target_id` (one entry each: amount summed, `kills` via the existing `gone`, `pops` via `DivineShieldLost` for that id), and `overflow_dealt` as the sum of `GameEvent::Damage` on the defender hero's id (`hero-p{controller}` of the target unit) with `via == Some(KeywordKind::Trample)`, `overflow_kills` via the existing hero branch. Sweep hits carry no `via`, so they stay ignored.
6. `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`: no logic change — `after`'s `PlayedAttack::read != forecast` comparison now covers the new fields automatically. Update the I18 header docs and `foreseeable_attack`'s list to state Cleave and Trample attacks stay foreseeable (their hits are board-projected), keeping every existing skip.
7. `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs`: add `mod r4290000_splash_and_overflow`, each case via `forecast_played` (forecast entry equals the real attack). Tests: `r4290000_cleave_splash_matches_the_real_hits` (middle target, both neighbours named, amounts equal real); `r4290000_splash_lands_when_a_shield_stops_the_main_hit` (dealt 0, pops true, splash dealt whole); `r4290000_splash_beside_a_giga_hits_once`; `r4290000_a_ranged_cleaver_splashes_with_no_strike_back`; `r4290000_trample_overflow_matches_through_armor_and_the_cap` (hero Armor 2 + Anti-oneshot, overflow equals real, kills agree); `r4290000_no_strike_back_or_defender_reports_an_overflow` (overflow `None` on hero-target entries; defender-side entries carry none).
8. `spec/rulings/R4290000.md` + `spec/pending/4290.md`: ruling `R4290000` ("The forecast names a Cleave attack's splash and a Trample attack's overflow", issue #4290), Hearthstone semantics (splash as dealt, overflow capped at the target's health then re-projected), `proven_in` listing `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs`, `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` (I18), `apps/web/src/game/attackOutcome.test.tsx`. Pending file holds the one `**[[R4290000]] … (issue #4290, 2026-11-20):**` paragraph. No §4.4 text change (derived fact).
9. Web: `attackOutcome.ts` add `splashFor(highlight, testId)` (the hovered entry's `splash` hit for this card id, via `highlight.hoveredAttack`) and reuse `outcomeFor` for the hero's overflow; `AttackOutcome.tsx` add `AttackSplashPreview` (same `PreviewMark` + skull/shield marks, `data-tentative`, `data-dealt`/`data-kills`/`data-pops`, `ATTACK_OUTCOME_NOTE` title) and `AttackOverflowPreview` (same, hero number); `Card.tsx` render splash marker when `splashFor` hits; `Hero.tsx` render overflow marker when the hovered entry's `overflow.dealt > 0`. Markers only: no combat math in the client (rule 7). Non-Cleave/non-Trample entries (`splash: []`, `overflow: null`) render exactly as today.
10. Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r4290000`, `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' r3100000` (no regressions), `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit` (testkit users), `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/attackOutcome.test.tsx`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. Commit any wire diff the `ts`-feature test run rewrites.

## Tests

- `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs`, `mod r4290000_splash_and_overflow`: the six `fn r4290000_…` tests in step 7; each asserts forecast splash/overflow values and `PlayedAttack::forecast == play_out`, i.e. the test fails if any amount, kill, or pop differs from the real combat.
- Fuzz/I18: no new test file; the extended `PlayedAttack` equality in `after` holds splash + overflow on every plain Cleave/Trample attack the fuzz plays (200-seed CI gate covers it; do not run the full fuzz yourself).
- `apps/web/src/game/attackOutcome.test.tsx`, new `describe("R4290000 …")`: `it("R4290000 aiming a Cleave attack marks each neighbor with its splash")` and `it("R4290000 aiming a lethal Trample attack shows the hero's overflow")`, plus `it("R4290000 a plain attack's preview is unchanged")` (`splash: []`, `overflow: null` renders no extra markers). Run with `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/attackOutcome.test.tsx`.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` must be green (ruling ↔ `r4290000`/`R4290000` ↔ `proven_in` linkage).

## Done when

- [ ] Cleave entries name every neighbour's splash and equal the real hits, including shield-stopped main hit, GIGA neighbour, and Ranged attacker.
- [ ] Trample entries name the hero overflow and equal the real overflow through Armor and the Anti-oneshot cap; no strike back or defender reports one.
- [ ] I18 holds the new fields on every plain Cleave/Trample attack (comparison extended, docs updated).
- [ ] Aimed Cleave previews mark each neighbour; aimed lethal Trample previews show the hero overflow; plain previews unchanged.
- [ ] `R4290000` cites the forecast tests, the fuzz oracle, and the preview tests in `proven_in`; `cargo jackioh spec check` green; the commands in step 10 pass.

## Risks

- Pool double-counting between `dealt` and `overflow`: both use fresh `ProjectedPools`, matching the existing convention (`hit_on_unit` is fresh-pool per hit); the real combat soaks pools across hits in order. If a pool-soaked Cleave/Trample case drifts, the `forecast_played` tests will catch it — narrow `foreseeable_attack` only if a concrete seed proves it, never pre-emptively.
- Hidden information: neighbours' shields/Armor are board-visible; the forecast still reads no hand, library, or face-down card (existing `r3100000_it_reads_only_what_the_board_shows` guards this).
- Wire shape: `AttackForecast` gains two fields; generated TS under `apps/web/src/wire/generated/` must be committed if the test run rewrites it, or web typecheck breaks.

## Open questions

None. Every choice the task left open is settled above (splash as a per-neighbour list rather than folded into `dealt`, which would lie about the target's blow; overflow reusing `projected_damage` rather than a second projection, per R3100000's no-second-maths rule; sweep excess rides along only where it falls out of that same call).
```

# Plan (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, medium)

## Goal

A Cleave attack's forecast names each neighboring unit's splash blow and a Trample attack's forecast names the overflow instance onto the hero, both with the same destroyed and shield-broken markers the target already gets; the fuzz's shared oracle holds both on every plain attack; aiming those attacks shows the splash markers and the hero overflow number. The AI's own splash pricing and Stinkyscape sweep weights stay out (open issue #4257).

| Path | New / change | What changes there |

1. `crates/engine/src/subsystems/lethal.rs`: change `fn struck_by` to `pub(crate) fn struck_by`. It already returns defender plus each adjacent unit via `giga::adjacent_slots` plus `is_adjacent_card`, GIGA-deduped (R3546001). No logic change.

Add fields `pub splash: Vec<SplashHit>` (default empty for non-Cleave) and `pub overflow: Option<TrampleOverflow>` (`None` for non-Trample, hero targets, and strike backs) to `AttackForecast`. Update the struct's doc comment.
3. `crates/engine/src/query.rs`, `forecast_attack`: compute the existing `falls` first and keep every existing field byte-identical. Then, only when `target` is a unit and the attacker has layered Cleave (`has_keyword(&mine.keywords, …)`, exactly as `combat::cleave` reads it): for each unit in `lethal::struck_by(state, attacker, defender)` after the first, set `amount` to `mine.attack + bonus.attack` (the unmultiplied `cleave_amount` that `combat::strike` passes to `cleave`, so lane multipliers and sweep weights never touch it), `dealt` to `0` when `falls` else `hit_on_unit(state, attacker, neighbour, amount)`, `kills` to `dealt > 0 && (poisons || exiles || dealt >= health)`, `pops` to `!falls && amount > 0 && is_shielded(state, neighbour)`.
